name: Icon trays
oneLiner: two recessed glass trays, each with a name, fill with app-icon tiles (glyph and label) that drop in one at a time; then the first tray drains to grey and falls back while the second lifts, gets a lit rim and its icons take the accent one by one
say: when the speaker sorts tools into two groups and moves the viewer from one to the other ("you know the chat apps... but the next wave is personal agents"): cut in on the first group; the second tray lights on the word that names it
